connector.name: X402station
connector.registryDescription: x402station.io: independent risk-signal layer for x402 endpoints before agents pay.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package x402station-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sf1nx account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: 0x-prefixed 64-hex-char private key. Account must hold Base mainnet USDC. Required for any paid tool call.

env.name: X402STATION_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional override. Only https://x402station.io or http(s)://localhost are accepted to prevent payload hijacking; any other value makes the adapter refuse to start.
